result.title: SciWorldBench: Do Video World Models Really Understand Scientific Experiments?
result.comment: Preprint. Benchmark paper with paired scientific experiments for evaluating video world models. 8 pages of main text, 16 pages including figures and references
result.summary: While the ability of video generation models to accurately depict scientific phenomena has received growing attention, determining whether these models genuinely understand the underlying principles remains a critical challenge. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate video samples in isolation, making it difficult to expose models that simply fit superficial visual priors. In scientific experiments, a small change in one condition produces a markedly different outcome even when the rest of the setup remains fixed. Capitalizing on this sensitivity, we introduce SciWorldBench, a benchmark comprising paired scientific experiments. Each pair varies a single condition in an otherwise fixed setup, yielding two mutually exclusive expected outcomes. Each generation prompt specifies the condition but omits the expected outcome. We evaluate ten text-and-image-to-video (TI2V) models using an independent vision-language model (VLM) that assesses each video without access to the condition text or the label identifying the correct outcome. A pair is scored as correct only when both videos depict their respective scientifically correct outcomes. Across all ten models, we find that the two videos in an experimental pair frequently depict the same outcome even though the conditions require different results. This recurring failure suggests that current video world models struggle to apply the underlying scientific principles reliably during generation. We will publicly release the benchmark dataset and open-source the evaluation code.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SciWorldBench，用成对的科学实验（仅改动单一条件、预期结果互斥）评测 10 个文本/图像到视频模型，并由独立 VLM 在不知条件与标签的情况下判定两段视频是否各自呈现正确结果，发现模型常对需不同结果的条件给出相同结局。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「单条件对照＋盲评」的配对设计可能可供核查，用于检验 LVR 的 latent 状态是否真正携带任务关键条件而非依赖视觉先验，从而判断答案对视觉证据的因果使用；但研究对象是视频世界模型生成，与 VLM 推理期内部表示距离较远，迁移需较多核查。
